verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Python, TypeScript, Go and Java SDKs, a UI/API, environment-variable tracing setup and an official MCP server. None of these is an official command-line interface. SDKs are developer building blocks and the MCP server is a different capability, so neither earns credit for a CLI story. A CLI is a fair axis for an observability platform like LangSmith, so missing evidence means none, not na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
